NOTE
OS:  This operator is only supported under the  Microsoft Windows  operating system.
Hardware:  This operator uses the Augmented Reality (AR) SDK of the Nvidia Maxine system and requires a 20, 30, 40 and 50 series Nvidia RTX card to operate.
The models for this node must be separately downloaded via the AR SDK for your  GPU  from  https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/broadcasting/broadcast-sdk/resources/ .
The Face Track  SOP  provides accesses to the fitted face mesh generated by the Face Track  CHOP . It can either be uploaded directly to the  GPU  for rendering or passed along to other SOPs for further modification. By default, the mesh is pre-transformed to align with the source face of the input image (x, y positions equal image u,v positions). However, you can also disable the pre-transform which will leave the fitted mesh at the origin in the original scale. The mesh can still be aligned with the image using the tx, ty, rx, etc channels of the  Face Track CHOP .
Note:   To use this feature you will need to provide a compatible 3D morphable face mesh file in Nvidia 'nvf' format to the 'Mesh File' parameter of the  Face Track CHOP . This file does not ship with TouchDesigner, but instructions on creating one are provided on the  Face Track CHOP  page.

parameters.label: Face Track  CHOP
parameters.name: chop
parameters.description: The path to the Face Track  CHOP  that generates the mesh.

parameters.label: Direct to  GPU
parameters.name: directtogpu
parameters.description: When active, the mesh will be transferred directly to the  GPU . This method is much faster, but does not allow it to be transformed further by additional SOPs.

parameters.label: Pre-Transform Mesh
parameters.name: pretransform
parameters.description: The fitted mesh will be transformed to align with the input image that was used to create the mesh. When disabled, the mesh will be positioned at the origin at its original scale.

parameters.label: Compute Normals
parameters.name: normals
parameters.description: Enable to automatically generate smooth vertex normals for the face mesh.

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims
parameters.description: Number of primitives in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_particles
parameters.description: Number of particles in this  SOP .

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.
